name: semantic_transfer_exploratory_collection_v1

authorization.accepted_scope: After clarification that no personal240-item review is requested, user agreed to collect frozen old chat L28 readouts and free answers on the existing unreviewed v5 inputs as exploration before independent semantic review.

amended_order: This separate exploratory collection may precede independent input review. It is not approval of the original formal study gate. Keep all original formal gates and protocols unchanged.

technical_smoke.selection: Longest input, shortest input, repaired poker conflict, and first-base missing-relation input; selected from frozen CPU lengths/metadata, not probe outputs. Generate once and reuse as the full-run prefix.
technical_smoke.failure: Preserve cached answers and stop; do not alter prompts/budget, retry the same inputs or classify empty/truncated outputs as refusals.

interpretation.former_eval_partition: Retain its identity only as provenance. These96 outcomes will no longer be an undisclosed prospective evaluation under the original pre-GPU-reviewed design after collection.
interpretation.later_labels: Any later input review or behavior scoring must retain timestamps, exposure and provenance. Do not silently relabel these caches as the original pre-review formal experiment or independent confirmation.
